title: Radisson reports stronger booking conversion from its ChatGPT plugin
friendlyTitle: Radisson is turning ChatGPT travel searches into hotel bookings
summary: Radisson says its ChatGPT plugin, built with Accenture, lets travellers compare hotels on maps and continue to direct booking. The company reports that early visit-to-booking conversion was about 1.5 times its organic-search rate during July and August 2026, though the figures are company-reported rather than independently audited.
friendlySummary: Radisson built a ChatGPT tool for finding and comparing its hotels. The company says early visitors booked at a higher rate than people arriving from normal search.
whyItMatters: Conversational assistants are becoming a new discovery and sales channel, not merely a place to ask questions. Businesses need to make their inventory and services usable inside AI interfaces while measuring whether recommendations, ads and conversions remain transparent.
friendlyWhyItMatters: People may start shopping inside AI chats more often. Businesses should measure the results and make paid suggestions clear.
